Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 221, "heading": "XX LE GUET-APENS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u221-r0126", "target": "Пленник вздрогнул и поднял глаза на Тенардье.", "source_sha256": "c7f9a55c182ff492fd0f77bc48f98f770c7a9818fc336946543134ab3fffede8", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u221-r0126", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "7ab13f1fd995cb63510b928d3bb69b602cfcd62731ab034fb203b01729c5af7a"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u221-r0127", "target": "— Пишите «дорогая дочь моя», — сказал Тенардье. Господин Леблан повиновался. Тенардье продолжал:", "source_sha256": "210ba5c7cd85ee6b74368bfe6d755e7e0198bc025589d971d8ecd7ddb56d1f47", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u221-r0127", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "5d67f4c94b6582031343cef53845412946151f9ca2505eed3a9f91edf1c0b306"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 8, "chapter": 20, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u221-r0128", "tag": "prose", "text": "— « Viens sur-le-champ… »", "sha256": "e4591d19ff96a35877acbe98efbd30907ddc9b7af9dea09c4dc185804812fde6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0129", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il s’interrompit.", "sha256": "cf92c287169b307508a0c937b6c70e728dbdf1818f8a99978d89c42942415a29", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0130", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous la tutoyez, n’est-ce pas ?", "sha256": "6626d885225ca2fd0de72307c8d0ea2ed98c4cac7a1156ad0f338196303eefc6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0131", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qui ? demanda M. Leblanc.", "sha256": "0aa815e83be5f78e03b368949651dd10659634ffebd6be4f5daffaaf13048463", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0132", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Parbleu ! dit Thénardier, la petite, l’Alouette.", "sha256": "2bad1898998666db303f65125ed5427d38770e10df171c673f66bf9d70672afe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0133", "tag": "prose", "text": "M. Leblanc répondit sans la moindre émotion apparente :", "sha256": "6387ed3fd5ce983e5a2358d2e80fcdfe23b6b4225e76bd1cd6875892ba40f2df", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0134", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne sais ce que vous voulez dire.", "sha256": "45155fbd55ab42b2a909941b380b556f27bd228a76790e577a66ec6ee37952e0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0135", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Allez toujours, fit Thénardier ; et il se remit à dicter.", "sha256": "9214fd6badb48735d820e6b4cff497beeace8954eb618057f52b6a7ff3f1e8d2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0136", "tag": "prose", "text": "— « Viens sur-le-champ. J’ai absolument besoin de toi. La personne qui te remettra ce billet est chargée de t’amener près de moi. Je t’attends. Viens avec confiance. »", "sha256": "68aa0b5d1945da769bfc1afa3f834ddfcc316e573faf754c6810601e4f2c9389", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0137", "tag": "prose", "text": "M. Leblanc avait tout écrit. Thénardier reprit :", "sha256": "ed7284bee75682043ee353dd87edf48611238d8893eb92ace96f05a11c298c29", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0138", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! effacez [[I]]viens avec confiance ;[[/I]] cela pourrait faire supposer que la chose n’est pas toute simple et que la défiance est possible.", "sha256": "9ed05d19e3b5735df5af250ca9a420abfb1afca2b5e94f3e7d833c84d5ffd6f6", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0139", "tag": "prose", "text": "M. Leblanc ratura les trois mots.", "sha256": "df21cd8c3b7c10dcc6daa85ae48e7aa106e64f39a75d23a0e4658c63c93b6cc9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0140", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À présent, poursuivit Thénardier, signez. Comment vous appelez-vous ?", "sha256": "b32c8933ca534b947866b79b49f67e369a3fde5f1efa987c5094a9ebe265f094", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0141", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le prisonnier posa la plume et demanda :", "sha256": "6c3866a9fcce53a8ff1d9d000d291e3cf2e0096f7599ffd2741e09bd816343cf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0142", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pour qui est cette lettre ?", "sha256": "a8e06337915d12f66c9132a4c9f0cd0f94aa6882f0e96480c157dab26aed5f06", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0143", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous le savez bien, répondit Thénardier. Pour la petite. Je viens de vous le dire.", "sha256": "f586a61188a448329f7c5aa83e154650e71c355ebd7d436faa001ee6c6146a6a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0144", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il était évident que Thénardier évitait de nommer la jeune fille dont il était question. Il disait « l’Alouette », il disait « la petite », mais il ne prononçait pas le nom. Précaution d’habile homme gardant son secret devant ses complices. Dire le nom, c’eût été leur livrer toute « l’affaire », et leur en apprendre plus qu’ils n’avaient besoin d’en savoir.", "sha256": "0faaa038bcba9c85d9ee913eeb7d022030690175b28bd4ebff1a2bc90389f378", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0145", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il reprit :", "sha256": "120e08ee0bf97237ab06d70a2481790418e0487166aa04486f548b5cde0cc203", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0146", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Signez. Quel est votre nom.", "sha256": "4de869ee81d8a0367a096cbb088d54dfcdd46a64e98168d228e67f2184934a99", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0147", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Urbain Fabre, dit le prisonnier.", "sha256": "b40582a4fd5a1b1020341048a78f111b5c101a4bf8485fa685618d44cb5f2e40", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0148", "tag": "prose", "text": "Thénardier, avec le mouvement d’un chat, précipita sa main dans sa poche et en tira le mouchoir saisi sur M. Leblanc. Il en chercha la marque et l’approcha de la chandelle.", "sha256": "a8fb4ebdd3746b4e1c7eb7c92dbd56da36b07d7e11e38d57f5f87f558212a66f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0149", "tag": "prose", "text": "— U. F. C’est cela. Urbain Fabre. Eh bien, signez U. F. Le prisonnier signa.", "sha256": "6835a3c8b173a1a313a71ea8466ba0436deeb42116b8031f8e1d7443a6bbb007", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0150", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme il faut les deux mains pour plier la lettre, donnez, je vais la plier.", "sha256": "56bfa4c15524d67dfc87c4d75d9e97bc78ce97eda14a910fce8f0ee66f81d357", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0151", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cela fait, Thénardier reprit :", "sha256": "2df911f0de64007ccfeec1ea7ccde8ec35f89aefedf8921e7a2bdcec57a395a1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0152", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mettez l’adresse. [[I]]Mademoiselle Fabre,[[/I]] chez vous. Je sais que vous demeurez pas très loin d’ici, aux environs de Saint-Jacques-du-Haut-Pas, puisque c’est là que vous allez à la messe tous les jours, mais je ne sais pas dans quelle rue. Je vois que vous comprenez votre situation. Comme vous n’avez pas menti pour votre nom, vous ne mentirez pas pour votre adresse. Mettez-la vous-même.", "sha256": "451b3f0616e1b0c9a92eca1ab3e722b88be077479677f812bf2c1e0c8cd9c60e", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0153", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le prisonnier resta un moment pensif, puis il prit la plume et écrivit :", "sha256": "587991a5ed774e9efdbab8cb05fe1ff036ff19567a816c95ffa9ac3d7a7652a1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0154", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mademoiselle Fabre, chez monsieur Urbain Fabre, rue Saint-Dominique-d’Enfer, no 17.", "sha256": "ade3100a8e0ea1015eed53390c7987343b37bfec195fea0a91e994fa95190e28", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0155", "tag": "prose", "text": "Thénardier saisit la lettre avec une sorte de convulsion fébrile.", "sha256": "f6ca573fd8f0304b3b59cd312ceb3dd74fc122143d82cd0d53b141822fb74ac1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0156", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ma femme ! cria-t-il.", "sha256": "2a187cdbd94c5833661fa5dac99eb4708cc925030c0769e76fa586a734336621", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0157", "tag": "prose", "text": "La Thénardier accourut.", "sha256": "4bfdd58bea4d26af591e7b4aceb332a0a5576feba107928da61e4aa61d099f2a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0158", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Voici la lettre. Tu sais ce que tu as à faire. Un fiacre est en bas. Pars tout de suite, et reviens idem.", "sha256": "8a095dda2ef311864bbd7ed198c8db06c6f214f5d5732b9e728c724d331bcbbc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u221-r0159", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et s’adressant à l’homme au merlin :", "sha256": "57547c91238fcd71d9eb7f11f74a3b579e23f21afe2bbc7acd6402e73e5ba7d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
